extracted.intended_audience: prospective applicants to AIM workshops (researchers, faculty, students in mathematics and related fields)
extracted.subtask_description: Information about upcoming American Institute of Mathematics (AIM) workshops, application status, and participation support (travel/accommodation funding) for successful applicants. Includes a note on the AIM-style workshop format emphasizing limited talks and organized group activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Places reserved for applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: Each AIM workshop has places reserved for applicants.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explicitly indicates that there is an application process and that applicants compete for a limited number of reserved slots.

rubrics_metrics.name: Funding for successful in-person applicants
rubrics_metrics.description: Successful applicants for in-person workshops receive funding for travel and accommodations for participation in the workshop.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applies to in-person workshops; funding covers travel and lodging to enable attendance. No further eligibility or amount details are provided on this page.

rubrics_metrics.name: Application-open indicator (*)
rubrics_metrics.description: The workshops marked with an * below are still accepting applications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: An asterisk next to a listed workshop denotes that applications are still being accepted for that particular workshop.

rubrics_metrics.name: AIM-style workshop format
rubrics_metrics.description: The AIM style workshop features a limited number of talks and significant time devoted to organized group activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Describes the intended format/structure of AIM-style workshops: fewer talks than a typical conference and an emphasis on collaborative/group activities; useful for applicants to understand expectations for participation and contribution.
